title: The direct image on finite Tor amplitude for a non-proper morphism
statement: Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$. Let $d\in\mathbf N$ and let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with $\dim X\leq d$, where dimension is the topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism, with separatedness as in [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $a,b$ be integers, and let $K$ be a bounded complex in the derived category of $A$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on the small étale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with constructible cohomology sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and Tor amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-kun-tor-amplitude]. Then the module-sheaf derived direct image $Rf_*K$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] is bounded constructible on $Y_{\Et}$ and has Tor amplitude in $[a,b+2d]$. No properness and no compactifiability of $f$ is assumed.

proof.text: The finite coefficient ring of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] is finite at positive level, and so is its canonical universe lift. By [lem-weil-l-adic-extension-integers-dvr], the element ell lies in the maximal ideal generated by the chosen uniformizer: its extended absolute value is the ell-adic norm of ell, which is less than one. Hence ell^n belongs to the nth power of that ideal and is zero in A. The finite-field cardinality in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] implies that k has characteristic p. Since ell differs from p, ell^n is a unit in k and therefore in the global sections of every k-scheme, including an empty scheme.

Apply [thm-dg-finite-type-constructibility] to the lifted finite ring A, with its annihilator ell^n invertible in k from Step 1, the two structure morphisms, and their compatibility with f. In Lean use its source-library bounded-constructibility formulation, boundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_of_locallyOfFiniteType. This gives bounded constructibility of Rf_*K without a properness hypothesis.

Apply the source-library dimension-bound formulation of [thm-sf-direct-image-tor-amplitude], torAmplitudeIn_rightDerivedLowerStar, to the finite lifted coefficient ring. Supply the positive annihilator ell^n, its vanishing action on K by coefficient linearity, its invertibility in the global sections of Y, and bounded constructibility of K. This is the same all-sheaf dimension bound, finite-constant projection formula and residue-test route of the unit, packaged for an arbitrary finite ring. Convert the input cohomology-vanishing predicate [def-kun-tor-amplitude] to the canonical t-structure Tor predicate by isGE_iff and isLE_iff, using a proved private equivalence for an arbitrary commutative ring; only the derived tensor and its curried tensor bifunctor are unfolded in that API lemma. The theorem gives interval [a,b+2d]; convert back by the same equivalences. No ordering of a,b is needed, so this includes an empty input interval. Pair this with Step 2.
